attempts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new full-bleed panoramic anime background painting, exact 3:1 aspect ratio, 3072x1024 pixels or larger (at least 3000x1000). Asset: a detective office at night for the formation re-investigation banner in a fantasy game. Input image 1 is a STYLE, CITY and GOLDEN SHIELD RING REFERENCE, not an edit target: match its refined anime background linework, painted gradients, rich indigo night palette, blue European mansard roofs, cathedral spires, warm windows and equestrian-statue plaza. New scene: inside a classic wood-paneled detective office at night, cozy warm brass desk-lamp light against cool navy moonlight. Camera looks broadly across the room, nearly straight-on back wall, readable clean silhouettes at banner scale. Place a LARGE CORK CASE BOARD entirely inside x=16%..52%, y=10%..63%. Around its margins pin small unlettered notes, diagrammatic maps and tiny city/location photographs joined by red thread, NO people or faces, NO writing. At the CENTER of this board place EXACTLY FOUR CLEAR EMPTY PORTRAIT PHOTO SLOTS in a balanced 2 by 2 grid: top row centers about (29%,28%), (39%,28%); bottom row centers about (29%,49%), (39%,49%). Each slot about 6% canvas width and 17% canvas height, slightly warm blank unmarked paper interior, thin pale photo border and pin at top; square to camera, unobstructed, red strings stay outside the four interiors. The four slots await CSS character portraits later: do not draw any faces or characters. A dark wooden desk spans the lower LEFT to middle foreground, with stacked closed case files and papers with no writing, a brass magnifying glass, a warm glowing classic desk lamp and a cold teacup with NO steam. Leave the lower RIGHT third as open uncluttered wooden floor, with quiet dark negative space from x=67%..92%, y=40%..100% to later overlay a chibi investigator about 60% of canvas height; no chair or furniture there. On the RIGHT back wall place a large tall ARCHED WINDOW, entire architectural frame within x=58%..84%, y=6%..76%, center about (71%,41%). Beyond it clearly show the SAME European fantasy city and equestrian-statue plaza from the reference. Through the upper window show ONE cracked ornate GOLDEN CIRCULAR SHIELD RING in perspective as a horizontal ellipse, center about (71%,26%), bounds x=62%..80%, y=16%..35%. Same thick engraved gold rim motif as reference, visible cracks and small gaps, but the ring is still hanging together in the sky, not collapsing, no shower of debris, no planet. Keep its entire ellipse visible between the window arch and distant skyline, no mullion crossing the ring. It will later have CSS light restoring its cracks. Soft gold glow, restrained teal haze over rooftops. Both board and window must lie wholly within x=15%..85% for crop flexibility. No characters, no humans, no faces, no text, no letters, no digits, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no inset panels, no border or letterboxing. All ages. Preserve the rich atmospheric quality and recognizable city/ring motif of the reference while making the office calm and investigatory.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the detective office in reference 4 as ONE full-bleed 3:1 panoramic game background, target 3000x1000 (or native supported 3:1 size; no interpolation). Reference 1, 2, 3 are the SAME approved chibi Gwen sprite: these are the HIGHEST PRIORITY STYLE REFERENCES, not characters to draw. Match their clean visible dark ink outlines, broad simple flat color shapes and only 2-3 cel-shaded value steps. Navy/indigo, muted teal, restrained warm ochre-gold palette. The scene must feel like the same animation production as these sprites, NOT a rendered concept painting. Reference 4 is COMPOSITION ONLY, abandon its ornamentation, polish and symmetric staging. Reference 5 is CITY AND CRACKED GOLD RING MOTIF ONLY, do not copy its detailed rendering. NO people or characters in the output; a real sprite will be composited later.
Composition: wide lived-in detective office, slight off-axis perspective and subtly uneven furniture, no perfectly orthographic showroom. Large plain wooden evidence board at x16-54%, y10-64%, large simple iron-framed window x59-83%, y5-72%; both stay entirely within x15-85%. Plain dark teal wallpaper, modest worn wood furniture, no patterned wallpaper. Desk fills left and center foreground, no desk on right. Keep x68-91%, y72-100% open quiet matte floor to receive Gwen. Chair with navy coat draped over its back sits left of center, NOT in the right foreground. Desk: uneven piles of loose case papers, folded map, crumpled note, plain cold mug and a visible cup-ring stain, magnifying glass. One or two loose papers on the floor at left/middle. Sparse hand-drawn scuffs only, no photographic grain or dense wood textures.
Board: recovered clues, with simple legible miniature illustrations on crooked pinned photographic prints, not random decorative photos: (a) solitary EMPTY wooden chair inside ruined walls, (b) HORSE-AND-RIDER statue in a European city plaza, (c) CLOSEUP OF A CRACKED GOLDEN RING in the sky, (d) a hand-drawn city street plan with NO writing. Put these around board margins. In board center EXACTLY FOUR traces where portrait photos were REMOVED: close irregular 2x2 arrangement, approximate centers (33%,28%), (40%,29%), (33%,47%), (40%,48%), each about 5% canvas width x15% height. They are faded lighter rectangular patches ON THE BOARD SURFACE, slightly rotated differently, small remnants of torn tape and one exposed pin each; no paper sheet, frame, white photo border, inset molding or outlined empty placeholder. The board surface is continuous across them, and these four patches must remain empty for team faces. Only 3-4 red threads, meaningful lines from evidence prints toward the central missing-photo cluster; no dense decorative web.
Lighting: ONE switched-on desk lamp at left center casting a localized warm pool up onto board and down onto the papers; the rest of the room dark with clear simple shadow shapes. No wall sconces, no other interior lights. Secondary focus is window sky with a suspended cracked GOLDEN CIRCULAR SHIELD RING seen as a horizontal ellipse, center around (71%,26%), bounds x63-79%, y17-35%, separated from the skyline and not cut by mullions. Distinct crack and broken gap, still hanging together. Simplify reference city's slate-blue roofs, towers, and equestrian plaza into clean readable cel shapes. Very restrained sky glow, no sparkling star field. Matte floor, NO glossy reflections, no cinematic gradients or bloom. Remove ALL fleur-de-lis, heraldry, flags, gold filigree, carved trim, decorative cloth, repeated motifs and ornate borders. Gold is used mainly for lamp light and ring. Character-compatible elegant clean line art with imperfect lived-in arrangement, not gritty realism. No text, lettering, digits, logos, watermark, UI or panel borders. All ages.
